content.text: Stimulates anterior pituitary to secrete FSH/LH which act on two types of cells within the ovaries: theca cells, granulosa cells
Stimulate theca cells of the ovaries to produce progesterone & androstenedione
Each follicle contains an immature oocyte (one egg), which is surrounded by a single layer of granulosa cells
Granulosa cells contain FSH receptors – FSH binds to FSH receptor and stimulates follicle and egg maturation
Granulosa cells also convert androstenedione to 17-beta-estradiol
Main hormone that works during the follicular phase to stimulate the proliferation of the endometrial lining
Responsible for uterine ripening to allow proper implantation of a fertilized ovum
